second-amendment.evidence: Co-sponsored HB 133 (2026), which repeals the 2018 law that raised the long-gun purchase age to 21 (passed the House 74-37 on 01/15/2026) and voted Yea.

end-homestead-tax.evidence: Voted Yea on HJR 203 (2026), the constitutional amendment exempting homesteads from all non-school property taxes (passed the House 80-30 on 02/19/2026).

pro-life.evidence: Voted Yea on CS/HB 289 (2026, House 76-34 on 01/15/2026); also voted Yea on its 2025 predecessor CS/HB 1517 (79-32 on 04/09/2025). The bill lets parents sue for the wrongful death of an unborn child and bars suits against the mother or against providers of lawful medical care, so it does not itself restrict abortion; abortion-rights groups opposed it.

back-police-order.evidence: Prime sponsor of HB 739 (2026), which eases the preemployment-exam rules for disability benefits of firefighters, law enforcement and correctional officers; it died in committee.
